proof_summary: Take $N=800{,}322{,}180$; monotonicity of $\binom{2k+1}{k}$ and $\binom{33}{16}=1{,}166{,}803{,}110>N$ restrict both binomial indices to $0,\ldots,15$. For every resulting pair, a finite factorization check shows that the residual either has the form $2^v t$ with $t\equiv3\pmod4$, or is divisible exactly once by a prime $p\equiv3\pmod4$, so it cannot be a sum of two squares.
